0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Sristialla appears to be in considerable distress.

48.original: Oh, stranger, please tell me you saw a group of four children while making your way here. I swear, they vanished in the space of an eyeblink!

49.original: I've told them it's dangerous to wander about by themselves, what with the damage from the riot and the sheer drop to the ocean below, but they never listen. And now I can't find them anywhere...

50.original: Would you please help me search for them? The longer they're left to their own devices, the greater the chance that they'll come to harm.

51.original: Honestly, I take my eyes off of them for a single moment...

52.original: Mother wants us home? But we're playing hide-and-seek!

54.original: Tell Mother that we're not going near the ocean, so we'll be fine. And tell <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103> if you find anyone else!

56.original: We'll go home when we're done playing!

58.original: If she wants us home faster, she can help me look...

60.original: Oh, for the love of─ But I'm glad that they're safe. Thank you.

61.original: I may be a bit too cautious, I admit. But you must understand, we have no way of knowing what's going on above. When that monster suddenly appeared in the sky, I didn't know what to think. And what if there are more?

62.original: I'm their mother─it's my job to keep them safe. And I will. Oh, I am going to make them scrub so many pots for this...
